Lumina-PO: hi team, we'd like to onboard a clinical triage model. must: no PHI in outputs, token-level redaction, add ~11k domain tokens, target p95 <= 320ms, prefer Private VPC. can redwood support?

Nina (CSM): capturing. tagging @Ethan and @Zara. renewal in ~50 days so we'll fast-track.

Ethan (SE): quick Qs: are token additions final or iterative? do you have 1.5k sample prompts + label schema? token index changes affect kv-cache/quant paths.

Lumina-PO (customer): token list mostly final; will upload CSV + samples today. we'll require KMS + disabled raw token logs.

onboard-bot: Secure upload link created: https://files.redwood.com/secure-upload/lumina-111 (expires in 7 days).

Zara (Safety): flagged. PHI rules: tenant-level raw-token logging disabled, KMS for artifacts, audit logs, and a prompt-injection + hallucination eval. fill safety intake: https://redwood.inc/safety-templates/lumina.

Ethan (SE): plan: run tokenization + conversion on Dedicated staging, then mirror to Private VPC. need: token CSV, samples (1.5k), label schema, optional model snapshot. ETA compat report: Fri EOD.

Caleb (RevOps): noted renewal timeline. I'll open a renewal-watch ticket and add onboarding milestones to acceptance criteria.

Nina (CSM): scheduling kickoff Thu 9am PT. acceptance criteria: safety signoff, KMS validated, p95 <=320ms on Private, token map ingested.

Lumina-PO (customer): thanks all, uploading now. we'll join Thu. :thumbsup:

Nina (CSM): action items: Ethan -> compat eval (Fri EOD), Zara -> safety review (tomorrow), Caleb -> renewal ticket, Lumina -> upload CSV+samples, Nina -> kickoff invite. updates will be posted here.
